title: Fabulous tour
text: We had a great tour and would highly recommend it, especially as a way to get acquainted with Seville on your first day. Our guide Emilio was extremely friendly and shared some really interesting stories about the history of the city. He also took the time to make sure we were comfortable throughout the ride. A fantastic experience and a lovely introduction to Seville!
author: Kathy_G

title: A great way to see Seville
text: We really enjoyed the Tuk Tuk tour of Seville! It was a great way to see the city, with a nice blend of the historic old town and the more modern/new areas. The tour was relaxed, informative, and a good introduction to Seville
